test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

The situation in the city is now fully **__under__** control.
solution:
The correct answer is **"No substitution"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Under control **is a phrase which means to be able to deal with something out of danger.
 
• Look at some **examples**:
 
 
• A terrorist started attacking Melbourne city, and suddenly the Australian Police came and they keep tried to keep things **under control**.
 
• It took two hours to bring the fire **under control**.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is: *The situation in the city is now fully under__** control*.
